Ward Round - 08/03/2020, 22:21 (consultant review, intensive care unit)

Background: Admitted to hospital at 22:09 on 07/03/2020 with confirmed COVID-19
pneumonia and severe hypoxaemia. Deteriorated over the following day and was admitted to
the intensive care unit at 18:07 on 08/03/2020 for escalation of respiratory support.

Observations: Temperature 38.0°C, HR 110 bpm, RR 28/min, SpO2 93% on CPAP with FiO2
0.6, BP 130/80 mmHg.

Bloods: CRP rising, Lymphopenia present, renal function stable, ABG showing mild
hypoxaemia with compensated respiratory acidosis.

VTE prophylaxis: Platelet count checked before prophylaxis and found to be normal; first dose
given on schedule. Enoxaparin first dose given 23:15 on 07/03/2020, continued once daily.

Escalation status: Full escalation of care is in place given reversible pathology; family updated
on deterioration and current management.

Plan: Continue CPAP with close monitoring of oxygenation, consider proning if no
improvement. Continue enoxaparin on daily basis and ABG. Discuss ceiling of care and
likelihood of invasive ventilation should further deterioration occur. Review with ICU
consultant on next round.

Ward round.
